caseName: Bank of America, N.A. v. Lee
caseNameFull: BANK OF AMERICA, N.A. v. Robbie Thomas LEE, et ux.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Petition for writ of cer-tiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and *1063case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of Bank of America, N.A. v. Caulkett, 575 U.S. -, 135 S.Ct. 1995, 192 L.Ed.2d 52 (2015).
